fired_rules.intake_context: Hyderabad latitude — adequate UVB available but indoor lifestyle + ~30 min commute likely limits exposure
fired_rules.root_cause_hypothesis: Severe Vit D deficiency. Cascade: ↓immune regulation (Th2 bias → atopic flare, eosinophilia), ↓Ca absorption, ↓T support (Vit D is steroidogenic cofactor), ↓mood, ↓sleep.

domain_interventions.N: Fatty fish 2×/wk (salmon, mackerel, sardines); egg yolks daily; mushrooms (D2 in vegetarian backup).
domain_interventions.R: AM sunlight 15 min/day on forearms — Hyderabad before 10am or after 4pm is ideal (UV index moderate, low skin damage).
domain_interventions.S: Loading: Vit D3 60,000 IU/week × 8-12 wk WITH FATTY MEAL · K2 MK-7 100 µg/day · Mg glycinate 300-400 mg/day at bedtime (also helps sleep). Maintenance 2,000-4,000 IU/day after retest at week 12. PHYSICIAN-SUPERVISED.

fired_rules.retest_signal: Vit D ↑ to 40-60 ng/mL in 12 weeks

fired_rules.intake_context: HPI confirms seasonal rhinitis (severity 4/10) — atopic phenotype confirmed. Recent travel to Bihar (rural India) + Thailand adds PARASITIC differential — both atopic AND parasitic load can elevate eosinophils.
fired_rules.root_cause_hypothesis: Atopic / Th2-skewed immune response, possibly amplified by Vit D deficiency. Parasitic infection cannot be ruled out without stool ova-and-parasite testing post-Bihar travel.

domain_interventions.N: Consider 4-week elimination trial of common triggers if rhinitis worsens (dairy, gluten, common nuts). Anti-inflammatory base: turmeric + black pepper daily, fatty fish 2×/wk.
domain_interventions.T: Avoid outdoor cardio on high-pollen/high-AQI days — Hyderabad winter (Nov-Feb) and Aug-Sep are pollen-heaviest.
domain_interventions.R: HEPA filter in bedroom · hot-wash bedding weekly (dust mites) · shower at night during high-pollen seasons.
domain_interventions.S: Quercetin 500mg × 2/day with meals [E3 — mast-cell stabilization] · Omega-3 2g EPA+DHA/day [E2 — Th2 modulation] · Vit D restoration is foundational [E2].
domain_interventions.M: Stress mediates atopic flares — current PSS-4 = 4 is low; not a primary lever for you.

fired_rules.physician_referral_specifics: Stool ova-and-parasite (O&P) panel post-Bihar travel; CBC differential repeat in 4-6 weeks; specific-IgE panel (aeroallergens — dust mite, pollen, mold) if seasonal rhinitis worsens; consider allergist consult if rhinitis severity ≥ 6/10.
fired_rules.retest_signal: Eosinophils ↓ to <4% in 90 days with trigger avoidance + Vit D restoration. If parasitic, much faster after treatment.

fired_rules.intake_context: Lean (BMI 24.8), libido active, mood good, no symptoms. This is an OPTIMIZATION opportunity, not treatment. Likely driven by: (a) Vit D deficiency suppressing steroidogenesis, (b) late dinner/circadian misalignment compressing deep-sleep (T peaks in REM/deep), (c) below-optimal Zone 2 base.
fired_rules.root_cause_hypothesis: Sub-optimal-for-age T, likely lifestyle-mediated. Will likely rise as Vit D restores and sleep architecture improves.

domain_interventions.N: Already on protein anchor (2 scoops whey/d). Add: zinc-rich foods — pumpkin seeds 30g/day, oysters/red meat 1-2×/wk.
domain_interventions.T: Already strong (3-4× PPL). Add: 90-150 min Zone 2/wk to build mitochondrial density (long run weekly, not biweekly; or 3×30min easy bike/treadmill).
domain_interventions.R: **HIGHEST LEVERAGE FOR T**: anchor bedtime by 11pm-midnight (currently late). Deep-sleep window is when T is made. Move dinner to 8-9pm (currently 11-12am).
domain_interventions.S: Vit D loading (already planned). Magnesium glycinate (already planned). Zinc bisglycinate 25mg/day [E2 if intake low].
domain_interventions.M: No direct mental-health intervention needed — PSS-4 low, mood 7-8. Continue current rhythm.

fired_rules.retest_signal: T ↑ to 600-800 in 90 days achievable with Vit D restoration + earlier dinner + sleep anchor + zone 2 ramp.

fired_rules.intake_context: B12 508 (adequate but not Tessera-optimal 500-900), folate 8.1 (adequate), ferritin 137 (good). Most likely a low-grade systemic-stress signal rather than nutrient-driven.
fired_rules.root_cause_hypothesis: Borderline RDW (top of normal). NHANES cohort data — RDW is one of the strongest aging biomarkers. At 14.1% the signal is mild but worth monitoring. Drivers: low-grade oxidative/inflammatory stress, partial nutrient repletion, or genetic variance.

domain_interventions.N: Continue iron-adequate diet (current ferritin 137 is great). Boost B12 to Tessera-optimal: increase egg/dairy intake; or maintain whey (small B12 source).
domain_interventions.S: Consider methylated B-complex (methylcobalamin 1000mcg + methylfolate 400mcg) — low-cost ₹400/mo — if budget allows.

fired_rules.retest_signal: RDW ↓ 0.3-0.6% in 90 days as Vit D + sleep + B-vitamin optimization compounds.

fired_rules.intake_context: Critically: PSS-4 = 4 (LOW), self-stress 4-5, mood 7-8, fatigue 1, brain fog 1. NOT chronic stress. But: dinner at 11pm-12am + likely bedtime 1am + sample at 8:53am puts the lab draw close to cortisol's natural peak (6-8am) on a delayed-phase schedule. Circadian misalignment, not HPA hyperactivation.
fired_rules.root_cause_hypothesis: Cortisol elevation is likely circadian-phase-shifted, not stress-driven. Late dinner → delayed melatonin → delayed sleep onset → delayed peak cortisol clearance → high-normal AM lab reading.

domain_interventions.N: Move dinner to 8-9pm (drop ~3 hours earlier). Light dinner protein + veg, save calorie-load for lunch.
domain_interventions.R: Anchor bedtime by 11pm. Anchor wake by 7am. 15-min AM sunlight ≤30 min after waking — directly resets circadian phase.
domain_interventions.S: Magnesium glycinate 300-400mg at bedtime (already in stack for Vit D synergy + sleep onset).
domain_interventions.M: Optional: 5-10 min slow-breath (4-7-8 or physiological sigh) before sleep — anchor parasympathetic shift.

fired_rules.retest_signal: AM cortisol → 10-15 μg/dL in 90 days with circadian shift (assuming sample drawn at consistent ~8am).
fired_rules._note: This is a NEW rule extending R-HOR-03 — separates 'circadian misalignment' from 'chronic stress'. Codifying it for the rulebook in next iteration.
